title: Sacaca 4-Year Encomienda Tribute Account (m_14 / m_15 / m_16 consensus, 1551)
source_citation: Textos Andinos m_14 (Hernando Achacata), m_15 (Luis Anba), m_16 (Pedro Horuro), Sacaca 1551; KFG textosbook
editorial_notes: Verbatim 4-year x 22-item canonical sequence recited identically by three independent khipukamayuqs (m_14, m_15, m_16). Uses majority/consensus across the three witnesses: yr-1 silver=21200 (m_14 & m_16; m_15=28200), yr-1 ovejas=500 (m_15 & m_16; m_14=300), yr-1 gallinas=103 (m_15 & m_16; m_14=130), yr-2 maiz=550 (m_15 & m_16; m_14=250), yr-2 sebo=16 (explicit in m_16; omitted in m_14/m_15), yr-2 huevos=1304 (m_15 & m_16; m_14=1004), yr-3 quinua=1.5 fanegas / 3 cargas (m_15=3 cargas; m_14/m_16=1.5 fanegas -> 3), yr-4 cera=4 (m_15; m_14=2, m_16=12), yr-4 sal=6 (m_14 & m_16; m_15=5). All 22 columns appear in fixed canonical order every year.
